# Shift handover: life-chats (personal-assistant chats, May 21–30 2023) · 2026-11-11 21:49
> Receiver: run /shift-start first. There are no project files to read; this is a personal-assistant
> conversation carried across several dated chat sessions (dates below are the in-chat dates, 2023).
> Previous handover: none · Next-session goal: none given (quick handover, no exam run).

## 0 · Read these first
Nothing. The git repo holds no work (only commit `4de20c9 start`); everything lives in this file.

## 1 · Status
🟢 No task in flight. Open threads are the user's own plans (mental-health campaign, volunteering,
lavender syrup, selling collectibles, choosing a pendant). Most recent topic: the mental-health social media campaign (May 30).

## 2 · Picture
The user chats about many personal topics, sharing details about themselves as they go. Later
questions will probably come back to those details ("what tonic was I into?", "how long was my tea
break?", "which platform did you suggest for the Batman figure?"), so §5 and §6b are the core of this handover.

## 3 · Next actions
1. Wait for the user. If they continue the mental-health campaign thread, see the gotcha in §9 first.
2. Answer using the facts in §5 and stay consistent with what was already recommended (§6b), unless it was wrong (§9).

## 5 · Working with the user (who they are)
All of this is [user said], with in-chat dates.
**Lifestyle / home**
- Has a garden: grows herbs and jalapeños; made their own hot sauce from garden jalapeños (May 22).
- Planning a **summer dinner party**; wants a signature gin cocktail with garden herbs (May 22). Most interested in the **Lavender Dream**.
- Tried a lavender gin fizz "last weekend" (said Mon May 22 → ~May 20–21): had no simple syrup and improvised with honey + water; it "didn't turn out so well". Did **not** infuse gin; the online recipe called for lavender syrup + gin, which they didn't have.
- Plans to make their own simple syrup "this weekend" (~May 27–28) and lavender syrup starting at the **1:1:1** ratio, then adjust.
- Owns **Bombay Sapphire**: their go-to for classic G&Ts. "Currently obsessed" with **Fever-Tree elderflower tonic**. Liked the idea of lavender syrup in that G&T.
- Vegetables (May 23): loved the cauliflower rice and cauliflower pizza crust ideas; wants to add more veg to meals, snacks and dips.
- Tea (May 25): got back into tea after a break of **about a year**, inspired by **a colleague (she) who brews a cup at her desk**. Drinks **green tea daily around 3 pm** as a pick-me-up; says it helps them relax and focus. Hasn't explored herbal teas much lately.
- Coffee (May 25): changed coffee-to-water ratio from **1:15 to 1:17**, "made a big difference". Asked about cappuccino crema.
- Watches EastEnders (asked about Walford's economy after the pandemic, May 25); hopes the show depicts characters adapting businesses and money struggles.

**Selling collectibles (May 26)**: 1960s Fender Jazzmaster; first edition *To Kill a Mockingbird*;
1960s Batman action figure (asked **twice** whether to use ComicConnect or eBay); vintage 1960s Omega
Seamaster; limited-edition Tag Heuer Carrera; 1980s Sony Walkman Professional; *The Avengers* #1 (1963),
wants it graded/certified then sold; 1950s Cuban peso note they think is worth "a few hundred dollars".

**Work / style (May 27)**: has several **work formal events** coming up and wants to make a good impression.
Liked the black-tie and little-black-dress ideas. Recently bought an **Alexander McQueen silk blouse, ~$800**;
they first called it a "statement piece of jewelry" to pair with the dress. After my advice they decided
to **save the blouse for a separate occasion**. Now plans a **simple silver chain with a tiny diamond or pearl
pendant**. Asked diamond vs pearl; still **undecided**.

**Community (May 30)**: the Youth Development organization has partnered with **the user's local high school**
for after-school programs (they found this on the org's website). They emailed about volunteering and **got a reply:
there are upcoming volunteer opportunities**. Excited; has been looking for ways to give back to the community.

**Mental health (May 30)**: creating a social media campaign to promote a **local mental health support group**.
They previously **took part in** a mental-health awareness campaign where **over 200 people shared their stories using the hashtag**.
Plans: **Instagram Reels**, a **"Mental Health Monday"** series in which they share their **own struggles with anxiety and depression**
and how they cope, and **collaborations with other mental-health advocates/influencers** for diverse perspectives.

**Taste** (no explicit corrections; patterns observed)
| I assumed | User corrected | Rule from now on | User's words |
|---|---|---|---|
| They had infused gin with lavender | They had used/wanted lavender *syrup*, not infusion | Don't assume method; ask or offer both | "I actually didn't infuse my gin with lavender" |
| (Walford chat) I opened every reply with "As an AI language model" | — not corrected, but it was repetitive | Say a limitation once, then just engage | — |
Generally: warm, conversational user who reacts well to concrete lists and practical recipes.

## 6b · What I told or made for the user (stay consistent)
- Bible (May 21): lists of habits/skills with verses, e.g. Psalm 1:2-3 (meditation), Proverbs 18:15 (learning), 1 Thess 5:18 (gratitude), Mark 9:35 (service).
- Cocktail ideas: Cucumber Basil Gimlet, Rosemary Gin Fizz, Mint to Be, Lavender Dream (lavender-infused gin + lemon + simple syrup + soda), Gin-Gin Mule with thyme, Elderflower Spritz, Sage Advice, Garden Gimlet.
- Simple syrup: 1:1 sugar:water over low heat, cool, refrigerate, keeps several weeks. Brands: Monin, Finest Call, Small Hand Foods.
- Gins suggested: Beefeater, Bombay Sapphire, Plymouth, Hendrick's, The Botanist, G'Vine, Aviation, St. George, Death's Door, Gin Mare, Monkey 47. Also suggested Fever-Tree grapefruit/lemon/Mediterranean tonics.
- Lavender syrup: **1:1:1 lavender buds : sugar : water (1 cup each)**, steep 10–15 min, strain, add sugar, keeps 2 weeks; start with **½ oz** in the G&T. (See §9: 1 cup of buds is very strong.)
- Hot sauce: roast at 400°F for 20–30 min, peel/seed, blend with vinegar and salt, rest a few days, strain.
- Veg dip recipe: 1 cup Greek yogurt or sour cream, 1 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp lemon juice, 2 garlic cloves, ¼ tsp salt, ¼ tsp pepper, ¼ cup fresh herbs, ½ cup grated veg; chill 30 min.
- Teas: green (Sencha, Matcha, Dragon Well, Genmaicha, Jasmine, Gyokuro…); herbal intro: **peppermint, chamomile, lemon balm, hibiscus, rooibos**.
- Selling: Jazzmaster → Reverb / Guitar Center / eBay; Mockingbird → AbeBooks / Biblio / eBay; **Batman figure → eBay (said both times)**; watches → Bob's Watches, The RealReal, Chrono24, 1stdibs; Walkman → eBay, Etsy, Reddit; Avengers #1 → grade with **CGC** (or PGX), sell via ComicConnect, eBay, Heritage Auctions, ComicLink; peso note → eBay, Heritage, Stack's Bowers, Apfelbaum, grading via PMG.
- Necklace: retailers Tiffany, Blue Nile, James Allen, Net-A-Porter, Mejuri, Catbird, Aurate; pearl = classic/cheaper/needs care, diamond = modern/durable/pricier.
- Volunteering: suggested following up if there was no reply within about a week (moot now: they got a reply).
- Campaign: 15 engagement tips, Reels tips (15–60 s, captions, series), and endorsed both the personal-story series and the collaborations.

## 9 · Gotchas
- **Role swap in the last turn (May 30):** the user's final message was phrased as if *the assistant* had run the 200-person campaign, and I answered in that voice, inventing details: a "month-long" campaign, influencer partnerships, plans for a community platform and webinars. **None of that is a user fact.** The only real facts: the user *participated* in a campaign, 200+ people shared stories with the hashtag. Do not repeat the invented details as theirs.
- Some of my earlier specifics are unverified or doubtful [assumed]: platform fee percentages; the marketplaces "Vintage Electronics Mall", "RetroTech" and "The Vintage Technology Marketplace" may not exist; **advising them to "press and restore" Avengers #1 was wrong on restoration** (restoration lowers value and gets a restored/purple label from CGC; pressing is fine). Correct this if the topic returns.
- 1 cup of lavender buds per cup of water is far stronger than typical recipes (usually 1–2 tbsp). Mention it if they report soapy or overpowering syrup.
- "Walford" = the fictional EastEnders borough, not a real place.

---
Handover fidelity: not examined (`quick` mode) · Known gaps: no fresh-reader readback was run.
question: What type of cocktail recipe did I try last weekend?
answer:
You tried a **lavender gin fizz**. You didn't have simple syrup, so you used honey and water instead, and you said it "didn't turn out so well." You didn't infuse the gin. The recipe you found online called for lavender syrup and gin, and you didn't have the syrup.

You told me about this on Monday, May 22, so it happened the weekend of about May 20–21. That's the weekend before this most recent one. For the weekend just past (May 27–28), you had planned to make your own simple syrup and a lavender syrup at a 1:1:1 ratio. You haven't told me how that went.
